title: 第26章 有人罩就是好第27章 这不就是付费上班
slug: 人在废丹房我九阳圣体凭丹近神
content_zh:
;;
唯有李安冷眼旁观，只是一眼他就知道兰月儿心中的想法，这些家伙，被人卖了，还在高兴的数钱。
不过这对自己来说是好事。
毕竟兰月儿的灵石，不就是自己的灵石吗？
而且，兰月儿此举，也是将不符合他们的身份地位的灵石给榨取出来，这也没什么不好。
他们不孝敬给兰月儿，总会踩在宗内某个坑里，将积攒多年的灵石，全都吐出来！
赵管事望着依旧坚定选择李安的兰月儿，对此越发有些困惑。
然而，兰月儿如今是九品炼丹师，虽然只是最低级的九品下炼丹师，可也是炼丹师，地位远在自己之上！
所以，他虽然不解，可并没有开口问，反正兰月儿是自己的人。
于是很快，在赵管事等人都很满意的情况下，兰月儿带着李安离开了。
众人无不是羡慕嫉妒恨。
特别是周通，身为之前一起上青楼堕落的朋友。
结果自己是堕落了，但这个有着同样癖好的朋友，却一飞冲天了？
这让周通在羡慕的同时，也是感觉有些难受。
明明大家之前都是在最底层，为什么李安就直接冲到了更上一层的阶级去了！
火工童子啊！
那可是外门杂役弟子当中的人上人。
从此以后，不仅有炼丹师撑腰，而且还能享受到一些宗门的资源，在外面，摆脱了炮灰的命运。
不行！
以后有机会，必须向李安请教一下！

李安都能行，自己也一定行！
有周通这样想法的弟子，并不在少数，他们望着李安跟着兰月儿离开的背影，都是暗下决定，一定要超越李安！
毕竟李安是废灵根，在杂役弟子当中可以说是垫底的存在，他都能废柴逆袭，他们自然也可以！
而对孙乾、廖房而言，也并非我完全没有机会。
一旦李安无法在火工童子的位置上坚持下来，自己就有顶上去的机会！
李安虽然突破到炼气二层，可与他们相比，差距还是很大。
而火工童子的任务，还是相对较为重要，李安之前从未炼制过丹药，这个位置，他很可能无法胜任！
自己接下来这几天，只需要多在赵管事这边刷一下存在感就好。
相信要不了几天，就会有好消息传来！
……
在兰月儿的带领下，李安来到了她的洞府。
洞府！
外门为炼丹师准备的休息之地，不仅依山而建，环境清幽，还在洞府当中留有阵法，可以汇聚周边的天地灵气。
不论是修行，还是回复，都有莫大的帮助。
这些东西，可不是李安之前作为底层的杂役弟子可以享受的。
可是如今，兰月儿成为明面上的九品炼丹师，这样的福利待遇，李安也是能跟着享受一些。

Only Li An watched with cold eyes. With just one glance, he could tell what Lan Yue'er was thinking. These guys were happily counting their money after being sold.
But this is a good thing for myself.
After all, isn't Lan Yue'er's spiritual stone his own spiritual stone?
Moreover, Lan Yue'er's move was also to squeeze out spiritual stones that were not in line with their status, and there was nothing wrong with that.
If they are not respectful to Lan Yue'er, they will always step into a pit in the sect and spit out all the spiritual stones they have accumulated for many years!
Manager Zhao looked at Lan Yue'er, who still firmly chose Li An, and became more and more confused about this.
However, Lan Yue'er is now a ninth-grade alchemist. Although he is only the lowest ninth-grade alchemist, he is still an alchemist, and his status is far above her!
Therefore, although he was puzzled, he did not ask. Anyway, Lan Yue'er was his own.
So soon, when Manager Zhao and others were satisfied, Lan Yue'er left with Li An.
Everyone is envious, jealous, and hateful.
Especially Zhou Tong, as a friend who went to a brothel together and fell into depravity.
As a result, he fell into decline, but this friend with the same hobby soared into the sky?
This made Zhou Tong envious, but also felt a little uncomfortable.
Obviously everyone was at the bottom before, why did Ang Lee rush directly to the higher class!
Pyrotechnic boy!
That was a master among the servant disciples of the outer sect.
From then on, not only did he have the support of the alchemist, but he could also enjoy some sect resources and get rid of the fate of cannon fodder outside.
no!
If you have a chance in the future, you must ask Ang Lee for advice!
If Ang Lee can do it, he can do it too!
There are not a few disciples who think like Zhou Tong. Looking at Li An's back following Lan Yue'er, they all secretly decided to surpass Li An!
After all, Li An has a useless spiritual root and can be said to be at the bottom among the handyman disciples. If he can counterattack as a useless person, naturally they can too!
As for Sun Qian and Liao Fang, it is not that I have no chance at all.
Once Li An is unable to hold on as the Pyrotechnician, he will have a chance to take over!
Although Li An has broken through to the second level of Qi Refining, there is still a big gap compared with them.
The task of the pyrotechnic boy is still relatively important. Li An has never refined elixirs before, so he is probably not qualified for this position!
In the next few days, I just need to increase my presence with Manager Zhao.
I believe there will be good news in a few days!
…
Under the leadership of Lan Yue'er, Li An came to her cave.
Cave!
The outer gate is a resting place prepared for alchemists. It is not only built against the mountains and has a quiet environment, but also has a formation in the cave that can gather the spiritual energy of the surrounding heaven and earth.
Whether it is practice or recovery, it is of great help.
These are not things that Li An could enjoy as a low-level handyman disciple before.
But now, Lan Yue'er has become a ninth-grade alchemist on the surface, and Li An can also enjoy some of this kind of benefits.
